children.value: answers, offline and from files already in the repository, whether a project can move to a target runtime. It lists each blocker, warning, and unknown with the exact lockfile or manifest entry behind it. Agents get the same answer through the

offing upgrade-check --to php@8.4 .
offing upgrade-check --to nodejs@22 . --json
The text output starts with the verdict, then one line per issue:

php@8.4: blocked (1 blockers, 0 warnings, 0 unknown)
composer.lock:9  acme/http-client@2.1.0  acme/http-client@2.1.0 requires php ^7.4, which excludes PHP 8.4.  [lockfile: require.php: ^7.4]
